rule: Everything behind the scoreboard (html, :root, body and any page-sized wrapper) is transparent. An exemption records an owner decision that a design's whole frame is the graphic; it binds the exact content hash, so any edit to the design ends it.

exemptions.reason: Courtside full-bleed board: the cream page colour (.board background #e9e5da on a position:fixed inset:0 main) shows between the two player cards and behind the event line. Listed for the owner's decision instead of being changed: either keep it as an intentional full-frame courtside display, or make the page transparent and give the cards/event line their own ground.

Courtside full-bleed board: the two halves and the footer bar cover the frame; the .board page colour #060b14 shows only as the 4 px centre divider between the halves. Listed for the owner's decision instead of being changed (removing it would cut a transparent slit through a full-frame graphic).

Full-screen full-bleed design: the radial navy gradient (.board, position:fixed inset:0) is the ground of the whole frame, the event title and round line float on it, and a full-width gold stripe (.board::before) runs along the top edge of the frame. There is no card element to carry the ground, so it is listed for the owner's decision instead of being changed: keep as a full-frame graphic, or restructure into a card (wrapper element around title, tie bar, line score and footer) on a transparent page.
